explanation: The boom is often traced to Living in Bondage (1992), a drama sold on VHS tapes. Most early Nollywood films went straight to home video.

claims.text: Nollywood is the nickname of Nigeria's film industry.
Nollywood does not refer to the film industry of Ghana, Kenya or South Africa.
Living in Bondage (1992), a drama sold on VHS, is often credited with starting Nollywood's home-video boom.
Most early Nollywood films were released straight to home video rather than in cinemas.
